+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}

+.SchematicPage .TexturePackSection .TexturePackList {
+  grid-gap: .6rem;
+  display: grid;
+  gap: .6rem;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(7rem, 1fr))
+}
+
+.SchematicPage .TexturePackSection .TexturePackList .TexturePack {
+  height: auto;
+  width: auto
+}
+
+.SchematicPage .TexturePackSection .TexturePackList .TexturePack .TexturePackName {
+  font-size: .95rem
+}
+
+.SchematicPage .TexturePackSection .TexturePackList .TexturePack .TexturePackAuthor {
+  display: none
+}
+
+.TexturePackList {
+  grid-gap: 10px;
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 10px;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack {
+  aspect-ratio: 3/2;
+  border: 2px solid transparent;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-shadow: .2rem .25rem 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  overflow: hidden;
+  position: relative;
+  transition: border .2s
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {
+  .TexturePackList .TexturePack:hover {
+    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 185, 20, .5)
+  }
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack.pad-focused {
+  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 185, 20, .5)
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .TexturePackList .TexturePack:active {
+    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 185, 20, .5)
+  }
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack.Selected {
+  border: 2px solid #ffb914
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack.Disabled {
+  filter: grayscale(1)
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack .TexturePackBg {
+  background-position: 50%;
+  background-size: cover;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack .TexturePackName {
+  align-items: center;
+  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
+  display: flex;
+  font-size: 1.4rem;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  height: 100%;
+  justify-content: center;
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  text-align: center;
+  top: 0;
+  white-space: pre-line;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.TexturePackList .TexturePack .TexturePackAuthor {
+  bottom: .2rem;
+  font-size: 1rem;
+  opacity: .6;
   position: absolute;
   right: .5rem
 }

+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.PurchaseWelcome {

+.PurchaseWelcome .PurchaseWelcomeText {

+.PurchaseWelcome .PurchaseWelcomeContinue {

+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone {
+  align-items: center;
+  border: 1px solid #ffb914;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: 1rem;
+  justify-content: center;
+  min-height: 12rem;
+  padding: 2rem 1rem
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone .ShaderPackDropZoneIcon {
+  font-size: 3rem;
+  opacity: .4;
+  text-shadow: 0 0 0 #000;
+  transition: opacity .3s
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone .ShaderPackDropZoneInstructions {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  font-size: 1.2rem;
+  text-align: center
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone .ShaderPackDropZoneButtons {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: .75rem;
+  justify-content: center
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone.ActiveDrag .ShaderPackDropZoneIcon {
+  opacity: 1
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDropZone.Disabled {
+  opacity: .5;
+  pointer-events: none
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDiagnostics {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  font-size: 1rem;
+  gap: .4rem;
+  list-style: none;
+  margin: 0;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+  padding: 0
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDiagnostics .ShaderPackDiagnosticLocation {
+  color: #ffb914;
+  font-family: monospace;
+  margin-right: .5rem
+}
+
+.ShaderPackDiagnostics .ShaderPackDiagnosticVariants {
+  color: #a4a4a4;
+  margin-left: .5rem
+}

+}

+  width: 2.2rem
+}
+

+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogPulse {

+  opacity: 0;

+.SkyblockReachLogButton.Pending {

+  line-height: 1.2rem;

+  right: -.35rem;

+    opacity: .6
+  }
+
+  to {

+    transform: scale(1.35, 1.7)
+  }

+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogPulseFade {

+  }
+

+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogIconJump {

+  to {

+  contain: strict;
+  inset: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute;
+  z-index: -1
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-harbour {
+  --island-glow: #3ce1c3
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-lamp {

+}

+}

+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogShaft var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 100% at 50% 0, rgba(60, 225, 195, .16), transparent);
+  height: 120%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: .6;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -10%;
+  transform: rotate(var(--tilt));
+  transform-origin: 50% 0;
+  width: 8rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogMote var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--island-glow), transparent 70%);
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: var(--x);
+  opacity: .12;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: var(--y);
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote.Violet {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, #c37dff, transparent 70%)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise var(--duration) linear var(--delay) infinite, SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway calc(var(--duration)/4) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 100%;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble:before {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(205, 222, 240, .8) 0 20%, rgba(60, 225, 195, .2) 45%, transparent 70%);
+  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 225, 195, .75);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  content: "";
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .35;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) - 4deg))
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) + 4deg))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .08;
+    transform: translateZ(0) scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .3;
+    transform: translate3d(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y), 0) scale(1.1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateZ(0)
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  80% {
+    opacity: .8
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translate3d(0, -100%, 0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway {
+  0% {
+    translate: calc(var(--sway)*-1) 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    translate: var(--sway) 0
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote,
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+    animation: none
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+    display: none
+  }
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogUnderLedger .SkyblockReachLogDepths {
+  display: none
+}

+.SkyblockTideChartCell {

+  display: block;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Cell-shore {

+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Cell-water {

+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Cell-clear {
+  background: rgba(38, 56, 120, .35);
+  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(236, 232, 255, .12)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Cell-lit {
+  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3ce1c3, #c37dff);
+  box-shadow: 0 0 .3rem rgba(195, 125, 255, .6)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Pulse:after {
+  animation: SkyblockTideChartPulse 1.2s ease-out both;
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(60, 225, 195, .9), rgba(195, 125, 255, 0) 70%);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  content: "";
+  inset: -40%;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Cast:before {
+  animation: SkyblockTideChartRipple 1s ease-out both;
+  border: 1px solid #ece8ff;
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  content: "";
+  inset: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartCell.Here {

+}
+

+    transform: scale(.4)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(1.4)
+  }

+

+  }
+

+  }

+.Baf2ColliderPanel {

+  }

+@media(max-height:420px) {

+    mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 calc(100% - 1.5rem), transparent)

+

+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Cryo {

+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Power {

+

+

+}

+.NxPipe {
+  align-self: center;
+  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px);
+  background-size: 10px 3px;
+  color: #838383;
+  display: block;
+  height: 3px;
+  margin-right: 5px;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Fuel {
+  color: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Water {
+  color: #3fd0f0
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Cryo {
+  color: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Power {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Waste {
+  color: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Store {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe:after {
+  border: 4.5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 5px solid;
+  border-right: 0;
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -5px;
+  top: -3px
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned,
+.NxPipe.Step0 {
+  color: #838383
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short {
+  color: #ffb914
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short:before {
+  color: #fcd373;
+  content: "!";
+  font-size: 10px;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -1.1em;
+  transform: translateX(-50%)
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step1 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow 1.6s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step2 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .8s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step3 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .45s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step4 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .25s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned {
+  animation: none
+}
+
+@keyframes NxPipeFlow {
+  0% {
+    background-position: 0 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    background-position: 10px 0
+  }
+}

+.NxGauge {
+  background: none;
+  border: 0;
+  color: inherit;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  display: flex;
+  font: inherit;
+  gap: 3px;
+  min-height: 0;
+  padding: 0
+}

+.NxGaugeTrack {
+  height: 100%;

+.NxGaugeTrack {
+  background: #1a1f2e;

+  width: max(.9rem, 10px)
+}

+  left: 0;
+  opacity: .85;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: 0
+}

+.NxGaugeBand.cold {
+  background: #5aa9ff
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.warm {
+  background: #ffb020
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.hot {
+  background: #ff7a2b
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.red {
+  background: #ff3b30
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.Store {
+  background: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.Empty {
+  background: #1a1f2e
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow,
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  height: 4px;
+  left: -3px;
+  margin-bottom: -2px;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -3px;
+  transition: bottom .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow {
+  background: #fff;
+  border: 1px solid #000
+}
+
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  border: 5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 0;
+  border-right: 7px solid #fff;
+  height: 0;
+  left: auto;
+  margin-bottom: -5px;
+  right: -7px;
+  transition: none;
+  width: 0
+}

+.NxGaugeSettle.Bad {

+}

+.NxGaugeTicks {

+.NxGaugeTicks small {

+.NxStatus {

+  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;

+.NxStatus.warn {

+}

+}
+
+.NxStatus.Explain {

+}
+
+.NxStatusWhy {

+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmapMapCanvas {
+  cursor: pointer;
+  outline: none
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmapMapCanvas:focus-visible {
+  outline: 2px solid #10243a;
+  outline-offset: -2px
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DCoordinates {
+  font-feature-settings: "tnum";
+  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
+  font-size: .75rem;
+  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+  left: .5rem;
+  padding: .25rem .5rem;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: .5rem;
+  white-space: nowrap
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DGizmo {
+  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  cursor: grab;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: .5rem;
+  top: .5rem;
+  touch-action: none
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DGizmo .StudioHeatmap3DGizmoEnd {
+  cursor: pointer
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DCrosshair {
+  height: 14px;
+  left: 50%;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 50%;
+  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
+  width: 14px
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DCrosshair:after,
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DCrosshair:before {
+  background-color: #fff;
+  box-shadow: 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .8);
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DCrosshair:before {
+  height: 2px;
+  left: 0;
+  top: 6px;
+  width: 14px
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DCrosshair:after {
+  height: 14px;
+  left: 6px;
+  top: 0;
+  width: 2px
+}
+
+.StudioHeatmap3D .StudioHeatmap3DUnavailable {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  font-size: .85rem;
+  inset: 0;
+  justify-content: center;
+  opacity: .8;
+  position: absolute
+}
```

</details>
